headline: Regular meeting cancelled and moved to a special session in observance of Veterans Day.
summary: The only item is a notice that the session was rescheduled. Residents may address items at the special session electronically or in person.
items: Cancellation notice: regular meeting rescheduled to a special meeting on November 18, 2026
location: Hamden Government Center, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
POLICE COMMISSION 
 
CANCELLED: REGULAR MEETING 
AGENDA 
 
5:30 PM, NOVEMBER 11, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Cancellation Notice:  
1. CANCELLATION NOTICE 
Please be advised that the regular Police Commission meeting has been rescheduled to a 
special meeting on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in observance of Veterans Day.  
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
